title: Decide whether Zarr, NetCDF, or HDF5 is ready
summary: A preview-only maturity review for multidimensional formats. It is deliberately non-runnable and non-GA: server source evidence exists, but no JavaScript adapter or public end-to-end canary closes the path.

maturity.supportTier: Preview-only architecture guidance; not a support claim
evidence: NetCDF-4 and geospatial HDF5 server evidence pinned to honua-server@61b7038e1887c98131aa217b6f0ae7869356a1f3
limitations: Zarr client and end-to-end states are unavailable; the server state is experimental and lacks a positive public canary.
NetCDF-4 and geospatial HDF5 client and end-to-end states are unavailable; server evidence is metadata-only and build-optional.
There is no public JavaScript adapter, runnable sample, stable bounded variable/subset contract, immutable live fixture, Studio action, or CLI command for these formats.
Geospatial HDF5 means only datasets that map to a documented coverage model; arbitrary HDF5 group browsing is out of scope.

walkthrough.title: Separate client, server, and end-to-end maturity
